partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Drug exposure, target expression, and disease anatomy coincide
results.hypothesis: A drug is more likely to treat a disease when the drug is reported in an affected anatomy, directly inhibits a top-ranked causal disease gene, and that gene is expressed in the same anatomy.
results.body: drug located in anatomy shared by inhibited top-three causal gene expression and disease location
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule triangulates exposure, target expression, and affected anatomy, but drug localization is SemMedDB-derived and may represent mention rather than measured tissue exposure.
results.trapi_notes: The positive graph motif and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; gene rank and disease ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Multi-target drug exposure in affected anatomy
results.hypothesis: The exposure-expression-anatomy mechanism is more credible when a drug inhibits at least two distinct top-ranked causal disease genes in affected anatomy.
results.body: R131 with at least two distinct inhibited top-three causal genes
results.mechanism_rationale: Two independently implicated targets connect drug action to the affected anatomy, although the SemMedDB drug-location edge remains an imperfect exposure proxy.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; distinct-target cardinality, rank, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS gene_count
WHERE gene_count >= 2
RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Active metabolite inhibits a causal disease gene
results.hypothesis: A parent drug can treat a disease when a distinct metabolite directly inhibits a top-ranked causal disease gene.
results.body: parent drug has distinct active metabolite that directly binds and decreases a top-three causal disease gene
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule represents a pharmacologically direct mechanism through an active metabolite, but the graph does not encode metabolite exposure or whether the metabolite concentration is therapeutic.
results.trapi_notes: The positive metabolite-target-disease path is TRAPI-expressible; excluding self-loops and applying rank and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:HAS_METABOLITE]->(metabolite:ChemicalEntity)
MATCH (metabolite)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (metabolite)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE subject <> metabolite
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Parent and active metabolite converge on a causal gene
results.hypothesis: An active-metabolite prediction is more credible when the parent drug independently binds and decreases the same causal disease gene.
results.body: R133 plus parent directly binds and decreases the same causal gene
results.mechanism_rationale: Parent and metabolite provide convergent directional target evidence, but coverage is expected to be very small.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; identity, self-loop exclusion, rank, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:HAS_METABOLITE]->(metabolite:ChemicalEntity)
MATCH (metabolite)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (metabolite)-[metabolite_effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene)
MATCH (subject)-[parent_effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
WHERE subject <> metabolite
  AND metabolite_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND metabolite_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND metabolite_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND parent_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND parent_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND parent_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
